## Teaching material this book builds on {.unnumbered}

The Part I scripts descend from the EE101 series. The original repositories are worth reading in full:

- `users/gorelick/EE101` and `users/gorelick/EE101-B`, Noel Gorelick
- `users/nclinton/EE101`, Nicholas Clinton
- `users/dag/ee101`, David Gibson
- `users/hadicu06/expertWorkshopJune_rev`, Hadi

Open any of them by appending the repository path to `https://code.earthengine.google.com/?accept_repo=`.

## Datasets used {.unnumbered}

| Purpose | Earth Engine ID |
|---|---|
| Optical, 10 m | `COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED` |
| Optical, 30 m, long archive | `LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2` |
| Radar, C band | `COPERNICUS/S1_GRD` |
| Radar, L band, annual | `JAXA/ALOS/PALSAR/YEARLY/SAR_EPOCH` |
| Elevation, 30 m | `JAXA/ALOS/AW3D30/V2_2` |
| Elevation, 90 m, global | `CGIAR/SRTM90_V4` |
| Foundation model embeddings | `GOOGLE/SATELLITE_EMBEDDING/V1/ANNUAL` |
| Mangrove extent reference | Global Mangrove Watch v3 |
| Canopy height reference | `users/nlang/ETH_GlobalCanopyHeight_2020_10m_v1` |
| Land cover reference | ESRI Global Land Cover 10 m time series |
